senses.def: A small lake on the Afon Glaslyn in Snowdonia, Gwynedd, Wales, approx. 1 km to 1 mile in length.
A lake in Snowdonia, Gwynedd, Wales; the main settlement on the lake is Llanberis.
A small village in Llanyblodwel parish, Shropshire, England (OS grid ref SJ2824).
A river in Bridgend borough, Wales, which joins the River Ogmore at Aberkenfig.
A river, the Afon Llynfi in Powys, Wales, which joins the River Wye at Glasbury (OS grid ref SO13).
The valley of the River Llynfi in Bridgend borough county borough, Wales.
Celtic deity who was the father of Manawydan; corresponds to Irish Lir
A village and community in Conwy borough county borough, Wales (OS grid ref SH8877).

ex: To enumerate all the llyns of Wales would take pages, but except Bala, there is scarcely one freshwater lake which is a main factor in any landscape of which it forms part.
